subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: Senior Planning Engineer — Building Permits, 1 opening, Grade 11. Justification: permit cycle time has run above the 15-day target since Circular 14/2026 took effect on 15 Jul 2026; senior review capacity and master-developer NOC coordination identified as the main gaps.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: Approved against the 2026 workforce plan (vacant position PBP-SPE-03). Budget confirmed by Finance on 26 Aug 2026.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: Agreed with Maryam Hassan Al Shamsi (Director, Human Capital): minimum requirements MIN-1 to MIN-5, and weighted criteria C1 Permit plan review & code compliance 25, C2 Structural & MEP review 15, C3 Planning regulations & master-developer NOC coordination 15, C4 Digital permitting & process improvement 15, C5 Communication & technical writing 10, C6 Team leadership 10, C7 Large & complex projects 10 (total 100). All criteria are job-related.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: Reviewed with Human Capital and the Digital Transformation Office. Protected attributes excluded from AI screening and evaluation and redacted from CVs before scoring: nationality, gender, date of birth / age, marital and family status, religion, photograph. Candidate name and contact details masked in the evaluation view. Emiratisation policy HC-POL-03 is applied only by Human Capital, as a separate recorded step after the job-related evaluation.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: Panel: Eng. Omar Yousef Al Hammadi (chair), Eng. Reem Abdulrahman Al Marzooqi (Head, Plan Review Section), Ahmed Khalifa Al Romaithi (Manager, Talent Acquisition). Structured interview guide mapped to C1–C7; signed consent form HC-F-22 required before any note-taking.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: Published on the MNDA Careers portal, shared to professional-network channels and two framework recruitment agencies. Closing date 28 Sep 2026, 23:59.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: Candidate privacy notice attached to the posting: application data is used only for this requisition; applications not selected are retained for 12 months after closure and then deleted; candidates may request access or correction via careers@mnda.gov.ae.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: 86 applications received. By source: MNDA Careers portal 54, Professional network 11, Employee referral 6, Graduate & national talent programme 5, Recruitment agency 10.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: 24 of 86 applications meet all minimum requirements; 62 do not. Unmet requirements (an application can fail more than one): MIN-1 degree 19 (13 field of study, 6 diploma-level only), MIN-2 experience 11, MIN-3 permit-review experience 26, MIN-4 registration 14, MIN-5 incomplete attachments 10. 15 applications fail two or more requirements. Rules use declared profile data and attachments only; no protected attributes were read.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: Human review of all 62 screen-outs. 9 near-miss cases checked against source documents (including a building-surveying degree, 7.5 years' experience, and three applications with a missing degree certificate or CV). Rules applied as published; no exceptions granted.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: 62 regret emails sent stating the unmet requirement(s); 24 candidates informed that their application has progressed to evaluation.

subject: APP-077-0047
detail: Eng. Reem Abdulrahman Al Marzooqi declared that she is the line manager of internal applicant APP-077-0047. Mitigation approved by the Director, Human Capital: a Human Capital observer attends any interview of this candidate and Eng. Reem does not score it. No other conflicts declared.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: Records of the 62 screened-out applicants restricted to Human Capital and scheduled for deletion on 28 Sep 2027 under the published retention period.

subject: MNDA-HR-REQ-2026-077
detail: Consented technical-interview notes uploaded for APP-077-0030 (6 Oct), APP-077-0041 (7 Oct) and APP-077-0072 (8 Oct), each with a signed HC-F-22 consent form.
